title: Boiling for Christ
description: In this sermon, Pastor John Piper emphasizes the importance of wholeheartedly loving and serving the Lord. He encourages believers to have intensity and focus in their devotion to God, not being slothful in zeal. The sermon is based on Romans 12:9-13, which instructs believers to let love be genuine, abhor evil, love one another, and serve the Lord fervently. Pastor Piper also highlights the freedom and joy that comes from serving Christ and not being bound by the law.
